name: fin_002_bank_reconciliation
description: Reconcile bank transactions to ledger entries, propose matches, and produce an exception and posting plan with an audit trail.

tenant_id.description: The unique identifier for the tenant or workspace.

entity_id.description: The unique identifier for the property or legal entity being reconciled.

period_start.description: The start date of the reconciliation period.

period_end.description: The end date of the reconciliation period.

bank_transactions_file.description: Path to the CSV file containing bank transactions.

ledger_entries_file.description: Path to the CSV file containing ledger entries.

match_tolerance_amount.description: The maximum amount difference to consider a match.

match_tolerance_days.description: The number of days before or after to consider a match.

require_human_approval_for_postings.description: If true, all proposed journal entries must be approved by a human.
